items.title: Odegaard gives dominant Arsenal win over Napoli
items.description: Martin Odegaard's superb strike gave Arsenal a deserved 1-0 victory over Napoli in their Champions League opener.

items.title: Baur's first Celtic goal secures victory against St Johnstone
items.description: Mika Baur scored his first Celtic goal as they extended the winning start to their latest Scottish Premiership title defence to six games.

items.title: Rangers snatch late win over St Mirren as sub Miovski extends winning run
items.description: Bojan Miovski's cute dink in stoppage time sealed a dramatic 1-0 victory for Rangers over St Mirren and extended their winning run to four games in the Scottish Premiership.

items.title: Newcastle still open to Hall sale - Thursday's gossip
items.description: Lewis Hall could still leave Newcastle despite new contract, Yasin Ayari close to committing to Brighton but Kaoru Mitoma set for exit, and Chelsea to go back for Manu Kone in midfielder search.

items.title: Liverpool come from behind to beat Atletico Madrid
items.description: Alexis Mac Allister scores an emphatic winner as Liverpool began their Champions League campaign with a win over Atletico Madrid at Anfield.

items.title: Liverpool come from behind to beat Atletico Madrid
items.description: Alexis Mac Allister scores an emphatic winner as Liverpool began their Champions League campaign with a win over Atletico Madrid at Anfield.

items.title: Marin's free-kick brilliance earns AEK victory over LASK
items.description: Razvan Marin's stunning free-kick earns AEK Athens a 1-0 win over LASK, securing their first Champions League points of the season.

items.title: Aston Villa ignite season in five-goal thriller against Club Brugge
items.description: Aston Villa launch their Champions League campaign with a 3-2 victory over Club Brugge in Belgium, ending their early-season goal drought.

items.title: Guirassy double and late own goal seals frantic Dortmund win
items.description: Borussia Dortmund's Serhou Guirassy scores a second-half double to secure all three points against Villarreal, despite the forward netting a late own goal to set up a nervous finish at Signal Iduna Park.

items.title: Betis twice come from behind to seal dramatic win over Lille
items.description: The Republic of Ireland's Troy Parrott scores the winning goal as Real Betis fought back from behind to mark their Champions League return with a thrilling victory at Lille.

items.title: Haaland strikes twice as Manchester City secure win at Porto
items.description: Erling Haaland scores twice as Manchester City open their Champions League campaign with a comfortable 2-0 victory away to Porto.

items.title: Mbappe and Valverde strike as Real Madrid edge Inter Milan
items.description: Kylian Mbappe and Federico Valverde were both on the scoresheet as Real Madrid opened their Champions League campaign with a 2-1 win over Inter Milan.
